title: STOKER’S 24C 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO
description:
STOKER’S 24C 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO

STOKERS 24C 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO is a classic loose leaf-style chewing tobacco product. Loose leaf chewing tobacco is the most common type of chewing tobacco. It simply consists of shredded tobacco leaves. Stoker’s 24C 16oz Loose Leaf has a robust tobacco flavor and is manufactured by National Tobacco Company. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experienced in plug and long cut. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Stoker’s brand page.
